(6) /api/cra/ai-monitor trend arrays are exactly length 7/30/90 for the range param. FRONTEND (Playwright): Admin login via Enter-in-password, tour dismissed. Executive Overview (/app): cra-exec-deadline + cra-exec-countdown visible; countdown ticks every second (28Days21Hrs33Min44Sec -> 33Min42Sec confirmed). cra-exec-compare panel present with cra-exec-compare-a, cra-exec-compare-b selects and cra-exec-compare-table. cra-exec-email-preview opens cra-exec-email-preview-modal with cra-exec-email-preview-frame iframe rendering the board email HTML. cra-exec-share opens cra-exec-share-modal with url (…/exec-overview/{token}), copy, revoke buttons. First card has rating badge (cra-risk-rating-*), fixes list (cra-risk-fixes-*), 5 mapped control chips (cra-risk-control-risk-0-*). Clicking cra-explain-toggle calls /api/cra/explain and renders cra-explain with ~888 chars of summary/detail/recommendation content. Clicking a mapped control chip navigates to cra-tab-controls (becomes active with bg-primary class); the Control Dashboard panel ("Controls & requirements") renders with 18 requirements. AI Assurance tab (cra-tab-assurance) -> cra-ai-monitor renders; 30d and 90d range toggles work (verified via re-issued /cra/ai-monitor calls); trend chart (cra-ai-monitor-trend) renders SVG AreaChart with connectNulls + forward-filled `line` field (see GroundingTrend). Public /exec-overview/{token} page renders cra-exec-public-page + cra-exec-public-kpis, invalid token shows cra-exec-public-error.

issues: Forward-fill logic in GroundingTrend (CraAI.jsx L236-281) is implemented correctly (carries last score forward via `last` accumulator + connectNulls on the Area), but because the org has only a few actual data points in the 90-day window, the visible continuous line still appears short — the line only spans from the first-real-day forward to the last-real-day. Chart still shows sparse output on 90d for orgs with little history. Not a bug, just a data-density observation. Consider back-filling to left edge with first-known score (or drawing a dashed baseline) if the UX goal is a fuller-looking chart on cold-start orgs.

action_items: (Optional) Consider left-side back-fill (carry first known score to day 0) in GroundingTrend so cold-start orgs see a fuller sparkline on the 30d/90d windows.

Public read-only endpoint correctly withholds product names (verified: pdata has no 'products'/'product_names' keys). Note the string 'product' still appears in the public JSON payload only inside disclaimer/note prose — no leakage of actual product names.
